decisions.reason: As a low-cost accessory that fits the firm's trailer business and after-sales focus, it is worth keeping unless demand proves clearly too small.
A box car trailer series is a core transport product for this firm and its home-page prominence suggests it is strategically important.
Car transporter trailers match the firm's know-how and customer base, though the more specialized niche makes them slightly more vulnerable than the main trailer lines.
Low-bed trailers are a natural extension of the firm's hauling range and support its goal of serving varied transport tasks reliably.
High trailer covers complement the existing trailer portfolio well and strengthen cross-selling, even if accessories can be trimmed more easily than full trailer lines.
This box car trailer series still fits the firm's core market, but possible overlap with another box trailer line raises the chance of later portfolio rationalization.
